purpose: Preserve the original FP32 task-cake projections only for the empirically precision-sensitive route while retaining the faster int8 cake execution for every other route.

triggering_evidence.finding: Quantization sensitivity is localized to route 4 by held-out evidence. No other route or capability regressed.

locked_execution.fp32_branch: Original gathered FP32 down/up weights and original MatMul nodes.
locked_execution.int8_branch: The exact v38 per-route, per-output-channel int8 construction.
locked_execution.branching: Two ONNX If nodes, one per cake projection; no prompt text, benchmark ID, or evaluator state is available to the branch.

screen_order: Run all 1,400 native functional rows and require zero regressions.
Run all 420/43,089 native general rows and require at least 0.95 parent top-1 agreement.
Only then run sustained and headline CPU benchmarks.
promotion: The exact hybrid graph must pass every quality, speed, TTFT, RSS, identity, physical, adversarial, and three-seed gate.
failure: Preserve and close route-local precision. Do not add another FP32 route unless a new held-out failure localizes there before speed is inspected.
